name: Boana VR
summary:
Boana VR is a fan-made Gorilla Tag–inspired game created purely for fun and made by the community. It features 3 unique horror maps, a challenging Only Up–style climbing tower, and a fully stocked shop to customize your look. Explore lively environments as a wandering NPC moves throughout the map, adding personality and mystery to your adventure.
This is not an official Gorilla Tag product—just a fan project made with love!
